description: Jujuba Software Puzzles lets you and your kids play with jigsaw puzzles on a touch-enabled tablet or on a regular PC with keyboard and mouse. There are many pictures to choose from and even more can be download from online websites or your computer. You can also snap a picture with your webcam and have the app generate a jigsaw puzzle from it. There are many difficulty levels to choose from.    There are many puzzles to challenge your brain and fingers.
